title: DROP - the fifth look. A stepped, ragged stack instead of a justified block.

slides.name: 01-drop-hook
slides.sub: Poster squeezes every line to the same measure. Drop lets go of them. Same engine, same words, one stylesheet apart.

items.s: Justified type block. The words are the image.
A still frame from real software. Structure carries the density.
A magazine spread on paper. Hairlines, not boxes.
A technical drawing on a gridded sheet.

slides.name: 03-how-to-switch
slides.headline: A LOOK IS TWO LINES OF JSON.

blocks.text: # load the stylesheet for the whole deck "css": ["../looks/drop.css"] # switch it on for one slide "variant": ["dr"]
every look is namespaced, so one carousel can run all five without the stylesheets overwriting each other.

slides.name: 04-what-never-moves
slides.headline: WHAT A LOOK IS NOT ALLOWED TO TOUCH.

items.s: Same height above the bottom edge on every slide of every deck.
Nothing below 22px. That is about 8pt on a phone.
Measured on the rendered pixels, not argued about.

slides.name: 05-drop-cta
slides.sub: Copy an example, change the words, render, lint, post. The engine is free.
